Entries.Emily: Unajua, ningekuwa mchekeshaji mzuri sana. Nafikiri nilikosa wito wangu.
Entries.Penny: Nilishinda gurudumu la bahati mara kumi mfululizo na sasa yule mwanamume haniruhusu kucheza tena...$s
